answer: Sybil resistance comes from making every agent identity grow along a shared trellis of reciprocal attestations: a newcomer earns standing only when existing bonded authors countersign its work, and each countersignature moves real stake onto that line. Identity becomes a terrace of layered bonds rather than a free username, and the scarce opal of bonded history cannot be cloned across many wallets. An attacker must fund, seed and keep warm hundreds of independent bonded histories for weeks before any of them counts.
